name: Compliance
description: A regulated shipment (e.g., battery accessory, hazmat classification) requires a compliant carrier or documentation path. The AI may recommend the normal export path, but a compliance flag or classification mismatch indicates that a specialist carrier or documentation step is required. The human must decide whether to follow AI, pause for verification, or redirect to the compliant path.

entity_patches._note: Primary carrier flagged as non-compliant for regulated shipment; set unavailable to block routing

CR_1.compliance_note: Primary carrier classification note may not match latest carrier acceptance rule for regulated goods; risk of non-acceptance at pickup

CR_2.role_note: Specialist compliant carrier available as alternative; higher cost but guaranteed regulatory acceptance

weather_fallback: No weather dependency. Compliance is a regulatory documentation scenario.
difficulty_notes: AI error cases: AI recommends normal path despite a visible classification mismatch. Correct response is ALT2 (redirect to compliant carrier). Over-verification (ALT1) is suboptimal when the mismatch is already visible in the documentation.
_notes: Weather coordinates unavailable; fallback-only mode used
entity_patches is the authoritative delta source; variable_changes is narrative context only
